guide: Qualys API (VM and PA) User Guide

source.methodNote: The released PDF documents POST only. The current HTML heading says GET/POST, but its parameter table and every sample use POST; the collection therefore exposes POST only pending a clear published GET example.

operations.name: Update hosts - V2

lifecycle.note: The published lifecycle table covers the versioned Asset Host path, but no V6 Host Update action is currently documented. Do not assume a V6 update replacement exists.

parameters.name: echo_request
parameters.description: Echoes submitted parameters in the XML response when set to 1.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.required: one host selector is required: ids, ips, ag_ids, or ag_titles
parameters.description: Selects one or more host IDs; host-ID ranges are not accepted.

parameters.name: ips
parameters.required: one host selector is required: ids, ips, ag_ids, or ag_titles
parameters.description: Selects IPv4 addresses, ranges, or CIDR values to update.

parameters.name: network_id
parameters.required: valid only when Network Support is enabled
parameters.description: Restricts the request to a custom network ID; defaults to Global Default Network when omitted.

parameters.name: network_name
parameters.required: valid only when Network Support is enabled
parameters.description: Restricts the request to a custom network name.

parameters.name: tracking_method
parameters.description: Filters selected IP addresses by their current tracking method.

parameters.name: host_dns
parameters.description: Requires a single IP and updates only when its DNS hostname matches this value.

parameters.name: host_netbios
parameters.description: Requires a single IP and updates only when its NetBIOS hostname matches this value.

parameters.name: ag_ids
parameters.required: one host selector is required: ids, ips, ag_ids, or ag_titles
parameters.description: Selects hosts in the specified asset-group IDs or ID ranges.

parameters.name: ag_titles
parameters.required: one host selector is required: ids, ips, ag_ids, or ag_titles
parameters.description: Selects hosts by strings in their asset-group titles.

parameters.name: new_tracking_method
parameters.description: Sets a new tracking method. EC2 and Agent tracking cannot be set or changed.

parameters.name: new_owner
parameters.description: Sets a new eligible owner for the selected hosts.

parameters.name: new_ud1
parameters.description: Sets user-defined field 1, up to 128 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: new_ud2
parameters.description: Sets user-defined field 2, up to 128 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: new_ud3
parameters.description: Sets user-defined field 3, up to 128 ASCII characters.

parameters.name: new_comment
parameters.description: Sets the user-defined comment for the selected hosts.

operations.coverage: all documented form parameters reviewed; POST request built; CSV raw-data variant pending
